response.overview: Centered around the Asiatic Cheetah, an endangered species, which was believed to have been extinct before 1996. "The Last Surviving Cheetahs" us a retracing of the director's journey to discover the Asiatic cheetahs in remote regions of Iran, and features footage gathered over 20 years of documenting and recording this animal.
response.title: The Last Surviving cheetahs
